name: Hand-carved, hand-painted neem wood Jagannath, Balabhadra and Subhadra idol set, approx. 6 in (Puri, Odisha)
supplier_cost_note: No supplier price found. Real Enterprises, Puri, Odisha (IndiaMART seller of wooden deity idols) lists several 6 in neem wood Jagannath trio sets, but the search snippets seen on 2026-11-12 showed no prices; m.indiamart.com cannot be opened from this session (DNS blocked). Kumu & Company, Puri (IndiaMART) priced only a wooden chariot (Rs 4,700). A wholesale quote from a Puri maker is needed. Do not use the Utkalika retail price (Rs 1,090) as supplier cost: that is a retail price, so the margin would be negative.
retail_observed: UNVALIDATED on Amazon/Flipkart/Meesho. Seen 2026-11-12: Utkalika (Odisha State co-operative handicrafts outlet) 6 in neem wood Jagannath, Baladev and Subhadra figurine set, INR 1,090, in stock (utkalikaodisha.com and hunarsetu.com listing); Hunarsetu 6 in handcrafted wooden Jagannath trio on acrylic base, INR 1,049, in stock; Utkalika 5 in-per-idol neem wood set INR 1,548, out of stock. No Amazon.in or Flipkart 6 in wooden trio listing with a price came up in 3 searches. Rs 899 is below the two Odisha retail prices but has NOT been checked against Meesho/Amazon. A cheap 4 in Meesho listing may undercut it.

A Puri seller lists 5, 6, 8 and 10 in neem wood trio sets. This is a supply-side signal only.

risks: No supplier cost: stays REJECTED ('no supplier cost yet') until a Puri wholesale quote is obtained. To reach about 35-40% cost at Rs 899, the landed cost needs to be about Rs 315-360 or less.
Retail not validated on Meesho/Amazon/Flipkart. Cheaper 4 in or resin/MDF Jagannath sets may undercut Rs 899. Check before any listing.

Religious item: images must be respectful, and listings should avoid any 'temple-blessed' or 'Puri Srimandir' claims without evidence. 'Neem wood' and 'hand-carved' claims need supplier confirmation (policy require_evidence_for_claims).
Hand-painted finish can chip in transit. Needs bubble wrap and a rigid box; the weight of under 500 g is estimated, not measured.
GST rate is an estimate (wooden handicraft statuettes, HSN 4420). The CA agent should confirm it.
